author: GitHub
description:
Five years ago, GPS set out to create a simple README file on GitHub to share cloud engineering knowledge. What started as a quick markdown document quickly evolved into Learn to Cloud, a free, open source platform with hands-on labs, progress tracking, and AI-driven verification. Watch to hear how the project grew to help thousands of developers land tech jobs.

#GitHub #CloudEngineering #LearnToCloud
